name: telegram-bio-bot
description: Telegram bot for creating bio profile websites

scripts.build: echo 'Building project...' && mkdir -p dist && cp -r public dist/ && cp index.js dist/ && cp package.json dist/ && cp .env dist/ && echo 'Build complete!'
